title.narrative: Réponses multisectorielles et intégrées WASH-Urgences, Child Protection aux populations affectées par les crises aux Nord Kivu et Sud Kivu

description.narrative: The main objective of this project is to meet the needs of displaced, vulnerable populations in North and South Kivu by providing access to water, sanitation and hygiene, access to education and protection (particularly children), through a multi-sectoral and integrated approach. This UNICEF project provides fresh water to affected households, builds latrines and improves hygiene, implements the CATI approach to prevent cholera outbreaks, and provides protection assistance to children and women. The project provides humanitarian assistance to 192,000 people, including 41,159 women, 119,000 children, and including 28,800 persons with disabilities.
